source_caption:
This final scene of Green Book (2018) is the ultimate payoff. When Dr. Shirley unexpectedly shows up at Tony’s family Christmas dinner, the hesitation is finally gone. The way they welcome him in without a second thought says everything about the bond they built on the road.

A reminder that friendship doesn’t care about where you start, only where you’re willing to go together. This film earned the Academy Award for Best Picture, with Mahershala Ali winning Best Supporting Actor for this performance.

source_details.title: Green Book
source_details.synopsis: Green Book is a 2018 American comedy-drama film directed by Peter Farrelly. Starring Viggo Mortensen and Mahershala Ali, the biographical film is inspired by the true story of a 1962 tour of the Deep South by African-American pianist Don Shirley and Italian-American bouncer and later actor Frank "Tony Lip" Vallelonga, who served as Shirley's driver and bodyguard. Written by Farrelly alongside Lip's son Nick Vallelonga and Brian Hayes Currie, the film is based on interviews with Lip and Shirley, as well as letters Lip wrote to his wife.
